Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Thanks for the questions and for walking us through the clinical triage flow. Per our call, I wanted to capture a compact evaluation plan so your team can review and flag anything missing. Attaching a printable outline for the trial (redwood-eval-outline-nova-20261124.pdf).

High-level goal
- Validate that Redwood Inference reduces average clinician query latency and achieves >=90% relevance on the stabilized prompt set while staying within your privacy constraints.

Proposed success criteria (primary)
- Latency: median p95 token response <= 350ms for the 512-token working set
- Accuracy/relevance: >=90% pass rate on 120 curated clinical prompts (we'll provide scoring rubric)
- Cost baseline: < $0.004 per 1K tokens served (goal metric; will vary by workload)

Secondary metrics
- Throughput: sustained 150 concurrent sessions without degradation
- Regression: no material drop in critical prompt responses during the 2-week run

Timeline & ownership
- Week 0 (Nov 29): Kickoff + environment validation (Redwood: Marissa; Nova: Alex + IT)
- Week 1 (Dec 6): Controlled run against 20 prompts; initial latency baseline (Redwood: Dylan)
- Week 2 (Dec 13): Full run against 120 prompts; relevance scoring and QA (Nova: Alex; Redwood: Grace)
- Week 3 (Dec 20): Review results + next-step decision (contract/SOW or iterate)

Trial environment options (choose one)
- Hosted API sandbox (fastest) — data does not persist beyond session logs
- Dedicated trial pool (reserved GPUs) — predictable throughput, logs available for troubleshooting
- Private VPC pilot (on-prem/VPC) — recommended if you need data-plane isolation; longer lead time

Immediate asks
1) Confirm the success criteria above or call out any changes by EOD Fri 11/26.
2) Confirm which trial environment you'd like to run (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC).
3) Share any mandatory security evidence we should prepare (SOC 2 report, network diagram, contact for signing the NDA).

We can convert the outline into a short SOW once you confirm environment and timeline. I’ve copied Marissa (trial ops) and Grace (customer success) to ensure rapid setup.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0143 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

- Success criteria: the relevance metric is good, but can we add a "clinically safe" gating criterion (no hallucination on medication-dose prompts) as a hard stop? We'd like an automated check on that subset (approx 30 prompts).
- Timeline: the week-of-Nov 29 kickoff works, but we need the trial window to extend into early Jan due to holiday staffing (so final review around Jan 8). Is a 6-week window workable?
- Data flow/security: our IT team needs to confirm whether the Hosted API sandbox is acceptable. We will likely prefer Dedicated trial pool or Private VPC for any real PHI. I’m copying our IT security alias; they will send a short questionnaire today (attached).

Can Marissa/Grace propose availability for a 30-min kickoff on Mon Nov 29 or Tue Nov 30?

Appreciate the clarity — Alex
